notes.title: The Cross Horror Game is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

it's finally here!


We're pleased to announce that The Cross Horror Game is now available on Steam! There's a 40% discount during launch week to say thanks to anyone who is lovely enough to pick it up:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1117120/The_Cross_Horror_Game

A brand new Indie Game Company The Next Generation Gaming, introduces their first Pc title ' The Cross Horror Game' addictive first-person survival horror game 

	The Cross is a survival horror game designed for Pc. The game follows zak as he searches for his missing daughter lilly and his wife after accident in the s.street Florida.  You find yourself stuck in a weird dark scarry haunted house which is infested with zombies, ghost, monsters, witches, and demons.
	The Powerful Unreal Enigne 4 Create Amazing 3D High End Graphics with Interesting Game Play and Stunning Haunted Horror Atmosphere.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35394414/913196b988b9e20b0a276421bdff7cbcf3cecb18.gif[/img]

» Amazing 3D High End Graphics
» Interesting Game Play
» Stunning Haunted Horror Atmosphere
» Challenging puzzles
» Spatial 3D Sound
» Paranormal activity

Release Trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LEOGW0VshFo


We just wanted to say a massive thank you to everyone We hope you can support us with your purchase so we can keep raising the quality bar so one day, we can produce a game that will forever be remembered.

Thanks all

Thanks for playing!
